title: Maintenance Specialist
description:
1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Direct message the job poster from Chrysos Corporation

Here at Chrysos we combine science and software to create technology solutions that are changing the global mining industry; both from a productivity and environmental impact perspective.

Just like atoms and machines, we believe that everyone is different and how individuals come together is what makes us successful. Headquartered in Adelaide and with team members based in Australia, Europe, Africa, North and South America, Chrysos Corporation’s diverse team of scientists, engineers and industry specialists are coming together to build technologies to provide rapid, accurate and safe ore analysis for the global mining industry.

The company’s flagship technology, PhotonAssay™, steps around centuries-old chemistry-based assay methods to deliver true ‘atom-counting’ analysis for the measurement of gold and other high-value metals. With successful global installations, Chrysos is taking PhotonAssay™ to customers around the world – Chrysos could take you to places that you might not have even imagined yet. There’s opportunity around every corner and the support to help you achieve your goals.

About The Role

The Maintenance Specialist, with support from the rest of the team, will be providing firsthand technical support service to ensure the smooth running of Chrysos PhotonAssay™ equipment.

This permanent full-time role supporting the Suriname site.

(We are open to FIFO)

What You Will Do

  • Maintenance and service of PhotonAssay™ installations in Americas region.
  • Scheduled monthly maintenance as well as responding to breakdowns on short notice to minimise downtime and maximise availability.
  • Technical support service for the installations via telephone, email, and remote computer login for troubleshooting and performance checks during and out of office hours as agreed. This will involve liaising with support staff at Chrysos’ headquarters and our technology partner in China.
  • Training of the customer on the safe operation and maintenance of the equipment.
  • Spares inventory management for each installation site.
  • Complete maintenance and spares documentation and providing feedback to customers.
  • Assisting in the development and continual improvement of the processes associated with the maintenance and service of PhotonAssay™ systems.
  • Assisting in the installation and commissioning of new installations.
  • Preparing fault records for statistics and reporting.
  • Assisting with Root Cause Analysis of faults (to improve reliability) and safety (to prevent incidents that could lead to injury or damage).
  • Assisting in the training of new Maintenance Specialists.
  • Scheduling maintenance events for site.
  • Performing other on-site duties delegated by Maintenance Manage.
  • Supporting the development of a strong WHS culture.
  • Safety first mindset always.

Who you are:

  • Demonstrated experience in maintaining technical equipment.
  • Strong customer service ethos and critical thinking skills.
  • Customer Service and Field Service experience in the mining or mineral sector (or related) processing industries.
  • Able and willing to travel and work within Americas region and overseas, including at remote locations such as mine sites.
  • Proven ability with proficient written and verbal communication skills.
  • Valid rights to work.
  • Proficient using software platforms for reporting to include the MS Office suite of products.
  • Tertiary qualification in engineering (electrical, electronic, mechanical, or mechatronic) or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Familiarity with the mining industry and mine-site operations.
  • Demonstrated experience in fault finding in electro-mechanical equipment.
  • Direct experience in one or more of the following areas: electrical wiring and safety, power distribution, mechanical maintenance, and repairs; basic electronics; metalworking; engineering drawing and design.

Who We Are (Our Values)

  • Safety is a Non-Negotiable - Safety isn’t just a value — it’s our way of life. It’s about creating a culture where physical and psychological safety are top priorities. We speak up, challenge assumptions, and hold ourselves accountable to protect one another.
  • One United Team – We thrive on trust, respect, and empathy. By embracing each other’s unique contributions and supporting one another, we build collective strength to solve problems, celebrate wins, and grow together.
  • Delighted Customers – Our customers, both internal and external, are at the heart of everything we do. By listening, understanding, and acting with care, we consistently go above and beyond to deliver exceptional experiences.
  • Always Improving – We are curious, courageous, and committed to progress. Every challenge is an opportunity to grow, and every step forward builds toward something extraordinary. Making or doing things better isn’t just a goal — it’s our mindset.

Why Join Us: Your Rewarding Career Awaits

At Chrysos, we value our team members and offer a supportive and dynamic work environment.

Here's what we have in store for you:

  • Flexibility and wellbeing initiatives to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Opportunities to work with groundbreaking equipment that's transforming the mining industry and reducing its environmental impact.
  • Collaboration with industry experts and the chance to grow and develop professionally.
  • Exciting career prospects and room for advancement.

If this opportunity aligns with your career goals, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply through the link below and let's explore the potential of working together.

Join Chrysos and be part of an innovative team that's shaping the future of mining technology!

Blue Orange builds enterprise data platforms and systems for a variety of clients, so this candidate should have experience with supporting modern data technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience with multiple data engineering technologies across multiple clouds and deployment scenarios. In particular, we’re looking for someone with experience in Snowflake as well as adjacent technology areas like DevOps, Databricks, SQL, Python, Spark, etc.

title: Data Engineer Pleno
description:
Sobre a Loggi

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a logística e a forma de fazer entregas no Brasil.

Queremos empoderar pessoas e transformar negócios com entregas de excelência. Movimentamos mais de 400 mil pacotes por dia com uma tecnologia de ponta a ponta, que aproxima todos os cantos do país. Temos o propósito de que as entregas sejam acessíveis para todas as pessoas do Brasil. Esse é nosso desafio diário, por isso, buscamos inovação em tudo que fazemos.

Por aqui, valorizamos diferentes formas de pensar, pois sabemos que só assim poderemos criar um futuro mais democrático para as pessoas.

Nossa cultura é traduzida todos os dias pelos comportamentos de cada Logger e das experiências que construímos com os nossos clientes e sociedade.

Valores

Somos conduzidos por quatro valores: Criamos o futuro, Entregamos soluções simples, Comunicamos abertamente e Vivemos o diferente. Eles são como um guia de como as pessoas devem se comportar diante das pequenas e grandes atitudes tomadas no nosso ambiente de trabalho diariamente.

Time de Dados

As equipes de Engenharia e Dados da Loggi são apaixonadas por desafios e buscam escalar um negócio transformador em um ambiente de constante aprendizado, tendo como compromisso a excelência para criar sistemas e otimizar processos, construindo assim uma plataforma de logística eficiente e inovadora.

Nossos desafios são de alta complexidade, mesclando profissionais experientes e em início de carreira, em um ambiente fortalecido pelo aprendizado e compartilhamento de experiências.

Usamos tecnologia para resolver problemas de eficiência e operacionalização, além de produzirmos uma solução de coletas e entregas dinâmica e única.

Temos também desafios em maximizar o sucesso de entrega e construir mecanismos de pagamento justos aos nossos entregadores.

Temos o desafio de trazer cada vez mais maturidade para a empresa no uso de Inteligência Artificial, Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, explorando novas metodologias/oportunidades, aprimorando a infra e processos (MLOps) e discutindo governança. Assim, viabilizaremos uma maior eficiência para o negócio alavancada por inovação.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de dados;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação, principalmente Python e SQL;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração de tarefas (ex: Airflow e Git);
  • Experiência em trabalho com sistemas de armazenamento em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos de forma proativa;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes data lake, lakehouse é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Spark, Terraform e Kubernetes é um diferencial.

Responsabilidades

  • Como Data Engineer, sua responsabilidade central será criar e otimizar os pipelines de dados, garantindo a integridade e eficiência no processamento. Você trabalhará em conjunto com outras equipes para entender os requisitos de dados e propor soluções inovadoras. Buscamos pessoas comprometidas com a entrega e um desejo contínuo de aprendizado e evolução em sua carreira na Loggi.

Benefícios

title: Tech lead
description:
Sobre a CLI Nós somos a CLI Consultoria, especialistas em integração de sistemas e gestão fiscal/tributária, com foco em simplificar processos complexos e gerar valor real para os negócios.

Nosso propósito é claro: descomplicar a vida das pessoas e empresas por meio da tecnologia. Atuamos em parceria com grandes players de mercado, como MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato e Thomson Reuters, conduzindo projetos desafiadores de transformação digital em empresas de grande porte.

O que realmente nos move não são apenas os sistemas que construímos, mas as pessoas por trás deles. Acreditamos que cada conexão, seja entre dados, sistemas ou talentos, é capaz de gerar impacto real.

Na CLI, Valorizamos

  • Inovação trazer soluções criativas para problemas complexos.
  • Aprendizado contínuo crescer junto, como time e como indivíduos.
  • Confiança e colaboração atuar de forma transparente, aberta e parceira.
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade liberdade para criar, com foco em resultados.

Somos uma empresa 100% remota, e isso nos permite unir talentos de diferentes lugares com um mesmo propósito: entregar excelência, sempre com o cliente no centro de cada decisão.

Estamos em constante evolução e crescimento, e isso só é possível porque acreditamos no poder das pessoas. Procuramos quem tenha brilho nos olhos, quem enxergue oportunidades onde há desafios e quem curta a energia de transformar, simplificar e inovar junto com a gente.

Se você busca um lugar para colocar suas ideias em prática, se desenvolver e fazer parte de algo maior, a CLI pode ser o seu próximo passo.

Bora crescer com a gente? #VemSerCLI

O desafio da posição

Como Líder Técnico(a) de Tecnologia, você será o elo estratégico entre clientes, liderança, times técnicos e áreas de negócio, conduzindo a arquitetura, operação e governança das soluções tecnológicas e de dados que sustentam a tomada de decisão e a inovação da empresa.

Seu papel é garantir a excelência técnica, a estabilidade operacional e a evolução contínua das soluções, conectando visão técnica e estratégica para assegurar que os ambientes e integrações de dados sejam escaláveis, seguros, íntegros e aderentes à estratégia da organização.

Atuará de forma prática e orientada a resultados, supervisionando implementações, guiando decisões de arquitetura, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança, qualidade e governança, assegurando que as entregas gerem valor real para os clientes e para o negócio.

Além da excelência técnica, sua atuação será essencial na liderança e desenvolvimento do time, fomentando uma cultura de confiança, aprendizado contínuo, colaboração e melhoria constante. Você apoiará a evolução individual e coletiva dos profissionais, conduzindo ciclos de desempenho, acompanhando PDIs, promovendo feedbacks construtivos e garantindo um ambiente saudável e produtivo.

Seu desafio é equilibrar visão estratégica e execução técnica, impulsionando a performance das plataformas e fortalecendo tanto a base tecnológica quanto a cultura humana da empresa, promovendo crescimento sustentável, inovação e resultados consistentes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir, revisar e garantir a aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e governança de dados.
  • Apoiar o time comercial e de arquitetura em atuações com o cliente, como por exemplo, kickoff ou agendas para falar sobre questões mais técnicas.
  • Conduzir decisões estratégicas sobre soluções, integrações e infraestrutura, alinhando tecnologia e negócio.
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento dos casos envolvendo o time que está sendo supervisionado, garantindo que não tenham demandas paradas, tirando empecilhos e apoiando.
  • Monitorar continuamente a performance, disponibilidade e segurança das soluções, garantindo eficiência e cumprimento de SLAs.
  • Antecipar riscos técnicos, propor soluções preventivas e conduzir revisões pós-incidente, assegurando estabilidade e escalabilidade dos ambientes.
  • Validar soluções técnicas propostas pelo time, garantindo qualidade, rastreabilidade, segurança e aderência a padrões de engenharia.
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de incidentes críticos, orientando decisões e priorizações de forma assertiva.
  • Garantir documentação técnica padronizada, atualizada e rastreável, assegurando transparência e histórico das implementações.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida das demandas (requisições, incidentes e melhorias), assegurando prazos, qualidade e satisfação do cliente interno e externo.
  • Monitorar indicadores técnicos e operacionais (tempo de resposta, performance, estabilidade, NPS técnico) e propor planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e de comportamento, inspirando confiança, autonomia e senso de dono no time.
  • Promover revisões técnicas e análises pós-mortem, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico e suporte diário aos integrantes da equipe, garantindo alinhamento e desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Conduzir feedbacks, 1:1s e planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDIs e PDAs), acompanhando evolução e desempenho dos profissionais.
  • Identificar necessidades de capacitação técnica, propor trilhas de aprendizado e fomentar o crescimento técnico da equipe.
  • Apoiar decisões de gestão de pessoas, incluindo contratações, promoções, férias e movimentações, em parceria com o time de Pessoas e Cultura.
  • Promover um ambiente de colaboração, transparência e aprendizado constante, fortalecendo a cultura técnica e os pilares organizacionais.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, compliance e governança de dados, mantendo integridade e confiabilidade das soluções.
  • Conduzir revisões técnicas periódicas e propor otimizações em código, processos e arquitetura, com foco em eficiência e inovação.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de qualidade, melhoria contínua e inovação em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento e operação.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura e integração e automação entre plataformas.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência em liderança técnica ou coordenação de times de tecnologia; Conhecimento em práticas de versionamento (Git), ambiente de teste/homologação, boas práticas de segurança, documentação técnica e observabilidade.
  • Experiência com plataformas de integração, como Mulesoft, Boomi ou Pentaho.
  • Diferencial:
    • Experiência com governança de dados.
    • Experiência com pipelines de dados, mensageria e automações.
    • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados.
    • Certificações em MuleSoft, Boomi ou Pentaho.
    • Atuação anterior em ambientes de consultoria ou prestação de serviços técnicos.
    • Vivência com SRE/DevOps.

Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Escuta ativa e empatia técnica: Compreender necessidades de clientes, colegas e áreas parceiras, traduzindo demandas de forma colaborativa e com foco em valor real nas entregas.
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva: Transmitir informações técnicas e estratégicas de forma objetiva, garantindo entendimento entre públicos diversos e promovendo alinhamento e confiança.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono: Antecipar riscos e necessidades, agir com autonomia e responsabilidade sobre resultados, assegurando continuidade e qualidade das soluções.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes: Manter rastreabilidade, precisão e qualidade nas execuções, controlando prazos, logs, SLAs e documentações técnicas de forma estruturada.
  • Visão sistêmica e estratégica: Compreender o impacto das decisões técnicas no negócio, conectando tecnologia, pessoas e resultados com coerência e responsabilidade.
  • Resiliência e equilíbrio: Manter serenidade e foco diante de crises ou pressões, conduzindo o time com segurança e postura construtiva.
  • Colaboração e liderança inspiradora: Atuar de forma integrada com diferentes áreas e perfis, promovendo um ambiente de confiança, reconhecimento e desenvolvimento mútuo.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua: Buscar inovação e aprendizado constante, aplicando novas ferramentas, práticas e lições aprendidas para evoluir processos, soluções e comportamentos.
  • Adaptabilidade e curiosidade: Ajustar-se a diferentes contextos e tecnologias com flexibilidade, aprendendo com as mudanças e contribuindo para o crescimento coletivo.
  • Postura ética e íntegra: Zelar por segurança, compliance e confidencialidade, agindo com coerência, justiça e transparência em todas as interações.

Benefícios

  • Auxílio Creche
  • Day Off de Aniversário

Por que fazer parte da CLI?

Aqui você encontrará um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e colaboração. Trabalhamos em ritmo acelerado, mas sempre com foco em qualidade, aprendizado e impacto.

Se você é apaixonado por criar conexões entre tecnologia e pessoas, e acredita no poder de transformar negócios através da integração, seu lugar é com a gente!

description:
Product Manager - Cartão Pós Pago

Join to apply for the Product Manager - Cartão Pós Pago role at ASAAS

Descrição da vaga

Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade! O Asaas ajuda empresas a gerir e automatizar seus processos financeiros e a melhorar o relacionamento com os seus clientes. Nossa conta digital é completa e reúne em um único lugar o envio e recebimento de cobranças, automação de comunicação por diversos canais e gestão de recebíveis descomplicada!

Na squad de cartões você será responsável por toda a experiência do nosso cliente com o cartão pós-pago, desde a gestão da fatura, rotativo e encargos, até a criação de funcionalidades de negociação e recuperação de clientes inadimplentes. Sua atuação é chave para a nossa estratégia de emissor, assegurando que o produto evolua e permita que milhares de empreendedores possam alcançar voos ainda mais altos. O Product Manager no Asaas é responsável por unir as necessidades dos clientes com os interesses do negócio e do mercado. Você trabalhará com times de engenharia, design e dados capacitados para te ajudar nessa missão. Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e executar a estratégia do Asaas como emissor de cartão de crédito pós-pago;
  • Definir a visão do produto com foco na jornada de fatura e inadimplência com o cartão;
  • Ser o ponto focal entre Produto e Compliance/Jurídico para garantir que todas as funcionalidades e fluxos do produto pós-pago estejam em total conformidade regulatória;
  • Realizar entregas que geram valor: entender profundamente o cliente para entregar a melhor solução possível, considerando ganhos e esforços;
  • Retirar obstáculos e entregar grandes projetos em pequenas partes coerentes e de alto valor;
  • Contribuir para a visão estratégica do produto, traçando metas com base nos interesses do negócio, momento do mercado e necessidade dos clientes;
  • Tomar decisões baseadas em dados e fatos concretos, definindo e acompanhando as métricas do produto;
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de design, engenharia e dados;
  • Assegurar que todas as áreas da empresa sejam consultadas ou informadas quando necessário, sobre alterações no produto, e também atuar em conjunto com a equipe de marketing na comunicação com o cliente, gerando engajamento;
  • Ser guiado pelo desenvolvimento constante, saindo da zona de conforto e testando novas formas de fazer as coisas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia como PM no produto de cartões;
  • Possuir capacidade analítica (facilidade em sintetizar dados e tomar decisões sem necessariamente ter todas as informações de um cenário perfeito);
  • Experiência intermediária em Gestão de Produtos Digitais;
  • Compreensão da dinâmica de encargos e juros de atraso (accruals) que incidem sobre o saldo devedor do cartão de crédito, sendo capaz de especificar as regras de negócio em produto;
  • Habilidade para ler e entender documentação de APIs de parceiros (como processadora), facilitando o discovery junto ao time de engenharia;
  • Conhecimento intermediário com análise de dados e métricas fundamentais de produto;
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL.

Diferenciais

  • Atuação em Fintech;
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de produtos digitais;
  • Familiaridade com registro de operações de crédito (CCBs);
  • Experiência prévia com o CADOCs regulatório de Cartões (3040, 3044, 3050);
  • Cursos de capacitação na área (Tera, PM3, entre outros);
  • Ensino superior em Economia, Contabilidade, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Carga horária de 8h por dia (segunda a sexta-feira — não compensamos os sábados);
  • Contratação CLT.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo :

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos :

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos :

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades :

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho :

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação :

Contrato PJ

Requisitos mínimos :

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos :

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e/ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Our Mission

Swapcard is the leading AI-powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in-person and hybrid events. We recognize the importance of teamwork in successful events; that's why Swapcard is fueled by a team of innovators who are passionate about helping organizers build future-proof events.

Our Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.

Our Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.

We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.

Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

Revenue Operations Manager

The main mission of the Revenue Operations Manager is to implement programs (tools, processes, good practices, reporting, etc.) that increase sales performance and efficiency.

We look for someone who has the capacity to have a Strategic and tactical approach on RevOps, as well as being hands-on to implement autonomously tools, processes, and reports.

The RevOps team includes 3 teammates who will report to this position.

Must-have

  • 6+ years experience in a high-performance sales organization, including one significant and successful position in sales operations
  • Experience in a SaaS company
  • Salesforce admin certification, very strong knowledge of Salesforce environment and good practices
  • Strong expertise in data manipulation, interpretation, quality
  • Solid understanding of the customers buyer’s journey + sales journey
  • Familiar with sales strategies, processes, and best practices
  • Persistent and optimistic
  • Knowledge of Sales tools, such as Chili Piper, Outreach, Avoma, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Scope of the role

  • Ownership of the Sales tools suite (Salesforce, Outreach, Chili Piper, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
  • Management of the RevOps team, coordinating projects and managing stakeholders expectations
  • Responsible for the implementation, management, adoption of these tools
  • Create and maintain reporting and analytics which will inform and advise sales leadership and individuals on performance
  • Accountable for the quality of data and the accuracy of reports
  • Collaborate with Data Ops to facilitate centralization and mapping of data, and to benefit from a global understand of our business journey.

Training and Performance Management

  • Onboard, train, and enable sales team members across geographies and disciplines
  • Assist the leaders of GTM teams to constantly monitor Revenue performance
  • Identify weaknesses and opportunities of our teams and systems
  • Work with Sales leadership to develop, execute, optimize and assess enablement program

Facilitation and process alignment

  • Conduct process mapping, analysis, and redesign to drive operational improvements
  • Assist sales leadership to set success playbooks
  • Serve as a liaison between Sales, Marketing, Growth, and Services teams
  • Maintain balance and drive of sales focus to address core strategic objectives while delivering to short-term revenue goals.

Goals

We expect a significant impact on:

  • Salesforce adoption from Sales (Good UX, good data)
  • Sales forecast accuracy (better pipeline management)
  • Increase in conversion rates
  • Reduction of sales cycle duration

Skills

  • Data-driven and analytical
  • Strong coaching and influencing skills
  • Great communication skills
  • Tech-savvy, resourceful
  • Natural problem solver
  • Project management skills

Swapcard’s Interview process

Our thorough interview process aims to identify exceptional talent to advance our mission while offering you a chance to explore your career potential at Swapcard.

1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.

2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.

3. Manager review with your future reporting manager

4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders

5. Reference check conducted by our people team

6. Offer

Values

Curious — We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow—what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.

Value-Driven — At Swapcard, we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.

Human — At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.

Resilient — We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.

Ownership — At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it’s about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

Benefits & Reasons to Join Swapcard

  • International team with 40+ nationalities (more on the way!)
  • Remote-first policy with headquarters in Paris
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities
  • Open-minded culture that appreciates differences
  • Feedback-driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset
  • Generous Paid Time Off to ensure you have time for what matters most ❤️
  • Remote perks designed to optimize your working experience
  • In-person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements ️
  • 100% of your health insurance contribution paid by Swapcard
  • Work-from-home budget (one-off contribution for equipment in addition to your initial equipment setup) ️
  • Co-working space budget to support remote work in professional environments
  • Learning budget to help you develop new and existing skills
  • Mental health care initiatives to support your well-being

Equal Opportunity

Swapcard is committed to upholding equal employment practices and making merit-based employment decisions. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply, regardless of race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, age, marital status, and status as a veteran

Mais detalhes sobre os nossos benefícios aqui:

Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Category Manager – Hard Services - What this job involves

Develop and manage hard service categories such as: MEP, FP, to achieve organizational goals by: develop category strategies, leverage scale, build supplier relationships, identify and bring forward market innovations, support client solutions and providing overall value to stakeholders in support of all JLL client managed spend.

Summary

  • Develops and regularly maintains short, mid and long-term category strategies aligned with overall business strategy and objectives and departmental stakeholders
  • Forges key strategic relationships with strategic suppliers and industry leaders and develops those relationships, being mindful of long-term mutually beneficial and ethical objectives as well as providing the business with access to supplier innovation
  • Manages category-specific segmentation of service providers and supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the category to deliver value to our internal and external clients
  • Shares market intelligence, best practices and provides category expertise in improving cost, performance and overall value to end users.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities.
  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. CM continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self-sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects
  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity and service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.
  • Utilize and enhance supply chain data analytics to assess current state needs and portfolio and enable more strategic thought leadership
  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level

  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed

Sourcing Process Expectations

  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of responsible spend
  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing-related functions- performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation
  • Partner with functional leads and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL and its clients
  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies
  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalate at appropriate times
  • Manage savings tracking and work with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts
  • Conduct supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations
  • Subject matter expert for category and main point of contact within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s Degree / Degree in Procurement or Supply Chain preferred.
  • 5-7 years procurement-related experience.
  • Excellent Inter-personal skills, Organization skills, Strong Analytical Ability
  • Ability work on a regional scale and across different time zones.
  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written
  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership
  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work
  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments
  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change
  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas
  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products
  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict timelines.

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and managing key accounts, promoting Synthego’s synthetic biology products, and driving new business.   • Develop strong, long-term relationships with clients ranging from bench scientists to senior leadership in the biotech and pharmaceutical industries.

  • Learn and evangelize the value proposition of Synthego’s phase appropriate synthetic biology products, supporting and development of cell and gene therapies from the bench to the clinic.

description:

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10+ years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

title: Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)
description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple:design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’sthe way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

title: Security Engineer
description:
1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full‑time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin‑backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing‑resistant approaches.

In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Application Security

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and software supply chain security.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and be comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Employment

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

title: Sr. Manager, Customer Success Account Management
description:
Company Overview

DocuSign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use DocuSign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, DocuSign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using DocuSign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you’ll do

The Senior Manager, Customer Success Account Management – Enterprise (Brazil) is a structured leader who prioritizes a Customer First mindset, responsible for ensuring governance, predictability, and scalable customer success across DocuSign’s Enterprise portfolio in Brazil.

This role oversees a team of highly skilled Customer Success Managers, driving operational excellence, retention, and expansion across a large customer base. Acting as a bridge between strategic leadership and field execution, the Senior Manager defines frameworks, processes, and rhythms that ensure consistent customer value delivery and measurable business outcomes.

This is a Sao Paulo-based leadership role that requires a strong presence both with customers and internal teams. The Senior Manager maintains regular customer engagement — virtually and in person — ensuring alignment between strategy, execution, and measurable outcomes.

This is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success Account Management.

Responsibilities

  • Champion a data-driven culture that enables transparency, prioritization, and early risk identification
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Enterprise Customer Success team, fostering accountability, clarity, and collaboration
  • Establish operational frameworks and success metrics to drive governance and consistency across accounts
  • Build scalable engagement models that ensure predictability and alignment between customer outcomes and company goals
  • Own Enterprise retention, GRR, and NRR targets for Brazil, ensuring performance through disciplined execution and proactive risk management
  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, Partners and Product teams to identify growth opportunities and improve customer lifecycle efficiency
  • Support strategic negotiations and customer escalations, balancing customer trust with business results
  • Ensure forecast accuracy, CRM hygiene, and portfolio visibility across the team
  • Leverage Gainsight, Gong, and Salesforce for customer insights, performance tracking, and decision-making
  • Define and monitor key health indicators to predict outcomes and guide strategic actions
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, feedback loops, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Act as the operational connector between Enterprise teams in Brazil and regional/global leadership
  • Translate global strategies into local execution plans, ensuring scalability and consistency
  • Represent Customer Success in strategic planning forums, advocating for customer needs and regional insights

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at DocuSign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within DocuSign. DocuSign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals within SaaS or enterprise technology companies
  • 3+ years of experience managing high-performing teams
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

Preferred

  • Proven track record in driving retention, expansion, and customer value across large portfolios
  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to translate data into operational strategy
  • Experience with Gainsight, Gong, and Salesforce to drive insights and execution
  • Deep understanding of SaaS business metrics (GRR, NRR, ARR, adoption)
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including C-level engagement
  • Demonstrated success implementing scalable processes and governance models
  • High adaptability, prioritization, and ownership in dynamic environments

Life at DocuSign

Working here

DocuSign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At DocuSign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
