title: Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform.

Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches.

In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Application Security

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

Ideal Candidate

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

Benefits

  • A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • A competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

description:
Our Company

Do you value extraordinary benefits, and one of the best places to work in the world?

What you’ll do

  • Approach the business strategically and set a multi-year north star vision and strategy for your business grounded in value. Proactively identify and achieve path to sales plan.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

description:
Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.
We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.
Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.
Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.
The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.
Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.
Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!
The Opportunity
We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform.
Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.
You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches.
In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.
This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.
About The Role
Application Security:
Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
Authentication & Identity
Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)
Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
Additional Security Domains
Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.
What You Bring To Ledn
10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
Experience with Secure Code Review.
Understanding of software supply chain.
Deep understanding of Linux internals.
Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
Nice To Haves
Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.
Culture Fit
We're looking for more than just operational excellence – we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The Ideal Candidate Will
Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
Have worked in a remote environment before.
A Taste Of What We Provide
As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
We remove barriers so you love what you do.
We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
Requests will be addressed confidentially.
Ledn Working Environment
Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
We are a remote first environment.

Esta não é uma vaga comum. Você terá autonomia para arquitetar soluções, otimizar processos e tomar decisões que impactam diretamente o produto e a experiência dos nossos milhares de usuários. Se você gosta de desafios complexos, domina o universo Cloud & DevOps e quer deixar sua marca em uma empresa de alto crescimento, esta oportunidade é para você.

COMO SERÁ SEU DIA-A-DIA:

Você será o ponto focal para a nossa infraestrutura e operações, liderando iniciativas nas seguintes frentes:

  • Arquitetura e Governança Multi-Cloud: Liderar a evolução da nossa infraestrutura na AWS, enquanto gerencia integrações estratégicas com Azure (IA) e GCP (Analytics). Você definirá padrões, garantirá a segurança e otimizará a topologia de rede (VPCs, Route 53, etc.).
  • Automação e Cultura DevOps: Acelerar a entrega de valor, evoluindo e mantendo nossos pipelines de CI/CD (AWS CodePipeline, Azure DevOps). Seu objetivo será automatizar deploys, reduzir intervenções manuais e fortalecer a cultura de integração contínua.
  • Segurança e Resiliência (SecOps & SRE): Atuar como guardião da nossa plataforma, gerenciando identidades (IAM), fortalecendo nossa defesa contra ameaças com AWS WAF, e garantindo a confidencialidade de dados com AWS KMS e Secrets Manager. Além disso, você irá aprimorar nosso sistema de monitoramento (CloudWatch) e resposta a incidentes.
  • Otimização de Custos (FinOps): Gerenciar o orçamento de nuvem de forma proativa, identificando oportunidades de otimização, gerenciando Savings Plans e negociando com provedores (AWS, Microsoft, Google) para maximizar o retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Sustentação e Evolução Contínua: Garantir que nossa stack tecnológica esteja sempre atualizada e segura, planejando e executando upgrades em bancos de dados (PostgreSQL), caches (Redis), runtimes (Node.js) e sistemas operacionais.
  • Capacitação e Colaboração: Trabalhar lado a lado com o time de desenvolvimento, criando ferramentas e processos que os capacitem para maior autonomia em ambientes serverless e na operação do dia a dia.

REQUISITOS:

  • Sólida experiência em arquitetura, administração e segurança de ambientes AWS.
  • Profundo conhecimento em automação de infraestrutura e pipelines de CI/CD (ex: AWS CodePipeline, Azure DevOps).
  • Experiência prática com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou CloudFormation.
  • Vivência em segurança de nuvem (SecOps), incluindo gestão de IAM, políticas de least privilege, e configuração de firewalls (AWS WAF).
  • Habilidade na criação e manutenção de sistemas de monitoramento e resposta a incidentes.
  • Conhecimento em administração de bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e sistemas de cache (Redis).

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Vivência em ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, GCP).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de FinOps.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e integração como N8N.

We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

Role Purpose

The Strategic Pursuit Leader (SPL) is the transformation architect and executive deal leader responsible for driving Adobe’s largest and most strategic enterprise pursuits (>$10M). SPLs sit at the intersection of sales excellence, transformation leadership, and executive storytelling – orchestrating Adobe’s full ecosystem, including partners and consulting firms, to deliver measurable business outcomes for customers.

SPLs are expected to operate as Adobe’s elite transformation sellers – the best salespeople, transformation leaders, and storytellers in the company – defining how Adobe sells enterprise transformation in an AI-first, partner-enabled world.

Mission

To lead a repeatable, scalable, and disciplined pursuit program that drives Adobe’s long-term revenue growth and customer transformation through AI-enabled, partner-aligned, cross-cloud solutions – acting as the single source of truth and accountability for all strategic pursuits in the $10M+ deal band.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Transformation, Not Transactions:
    1. Serve as the executive strategist and deal owner for enterprise-scale pursuits. Partner with customer executives to define a North Star transformation vision that connects business outcomes, AI strategy, and Adobe’s capabilities. Translate complex enterprise change into measurable business impact.
  • Command the Pursuit Business:
    1. Own the qualification, strategy, and execution of each $10M+ pursuit. Drive forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and deal velocity with precision and urgency. Lead pursuit planning and orchestration across Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Professional Services, and Partners.
  • Orchestrate the Ecosystem:
    1. Mobilize Adobe’s internal and external ecosystem – including Deal Desk, Legal, Product, Consulting, Partners, GSIs, and agencies – to deliver unified pursuit execution. Build trusted relationships with consulting firms and hyperscalers to co-create transformation strategies that scale.
  • Master Storytelling & Executive Engagement:
    1. Craft and deliver C-suite-level transformation narratives that inspire confidence and action. Present Adobe’s AI-first story through compelling storytelling that integrates creativity, data, and intelligence. Be recognized as a thought leader on digital transformation and enterprise value realization.
  • Drive Industry, Partner & AI Expertise:
    1. Maintain deep understanding of assigned industries, partner ecosystems, and AI adoption trends. Leverage customer and partner insights to shape differentiated value narratives. Stay ahead of market evolution through continuous learning and engagement with Adobe’s AI and partner teams.
  • Exhibit Leadership & Enablement Excellence:
    1. Demonstrate consistent participation in the SPL Mastery Curriculum, enablement programs, and cross-functional sessions. Model accountability, preparation, and composure. Lead by example and mentor peers through field shadowing, retrospectives, and co-led pursuits.

    1. Represent Adobe’s transformation leadership both internally and externally. Contribute to LinkedIn thought leadership, industry storytelling, and customer transformation showcases. Elevate Adobe’s reputation through professional visibility and partnership engagement.

Required Experience & Attributes

  • 10+ years in enterprise software, SaaS, or consulting with consistent quota attainment on $10M+ opportunities.
  • Proven ability to lead multi-year, multi-stakeholder digital transformation engagements.
  • Executive presence – credible with C-suite leaders across business, IT, and partner ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales methodology, value-based selling, and outcome-based commercial structures.
  • Strong knowledge of AI trends, partner ecosystems, and consulting firm collaboration models.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills – able to simplify complexity and inspire confidence.
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity, high-stakes negotiations, and accountability across cross-functional and partner teams.
  • Industry specialization or AI solution familiarity preferred (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Technology).

Think Boldly. Operate with Precision. Lead from the Front.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Drive cross-product impact: Work across multiple product domains simultaneously—building experiments in Proposals, optimizing onboarding flows, and developing features that directly impact acquisition, monetization, and retention metrics
  • Move fast, responsibly: Operate in a Kanban environment where priorities shift based on experiment results and business needs, requiring you to balance rapid iteration with quality engineering practices
  • Own end-to-end user journeys: Build features that span the entire customer lifecycle—from signup and onboarding to subscription upgrades and hand-offs to implementation teams
  • Pioneer AI-driven experiences: Develop and iterate on novel AI-enhanced workflows and experiments that represent the cutting edge of roofing industry technology
  • Lead with autonomy: Work in a self-directed environment with our product designer and Growth EM, taking ownership of product decisions and driving features from conception to delivery
  • Build with experimentation in mind: Rapidly set up A/B tests and feature variations, prototype new experiences to drive user value, and help us learn and iterate on growth strategies with measurable business impact
  • Develop full-stack solutions: Build performant React components and work with Laravel backend following DDD patterns to create robust, scalable features that maintain code quality while enabling rapid experimentation
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: Know when to optimize for speed vs. complexity, always considering the unique needs of cross-domain features and growth experimentation
  • Shape the future of roofing software: Join a small, passionate team where your individual contributions directly influence product direction and company growth trajectory

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Strong full-stack foundation: 5+ years of experience with JavaScript, React, and backend development (preferably OOP with Laravel/PHP), with 2+ years building scalable, multi-tenant SaaS products that serve real users
  • Database expertise : Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Growth engineering mindset: Experience building for experimentation and metrics-driven iteration, with a track record of breaking down complex problems into testable proofs-of-concept and rapid experiments
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with marketing, product, and design teams, consistently communicating technical tradeoffs to meet both user needs and business requirements
  • Autonomous problem-solving: You’re comfortable with ambiguity and scoping solutions independently, while knowing when to collaborate. You thrive in early-stage environments where priorities shift and individual ownership drives real impact
  • User-centered: You’ll have a deep belief that great products serve users while growing the business, with experience building accessible, reliable experiences that earn customer trust
  • A focus on quality: You value testing and documentation as much as code, and excel at making smart tradeoffs between complexity and speed to ship the right things quickly
  • Curiosity: A genuine motivation to move metrics and grow the business through thoughtful product decisions, not just technical execution

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience on a growth team or working on acquisition/monetization initiatives
  • Data-driven mindset with curiosity about user analytics and behavioural patterns
  • An eye for visuals. Design skills aren’t required, but you can think critically about existing designs
  • Experience building AI workflows in production, or the curiosity to learn
  • Experience with A/B testing tools (Google Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, etc.)

title: Supervisor Comercial - Vendas Varejo / Bens de Consumo
description:
Região de Engenheiro Coelho / Campinas, SP (com disponibilidade para viagens)

Contratante: indústria brasileira em plena expansão, dedicada a fabricar e distribuir produtos de higiene e limpeza, com forte compromisso com a qualidade e o meio ambiente.

Atendimento exclusivo B2B, focado na personalização e na melhor relação custo-benefício. Estamos em um momento decisivo de crescimento, profissionalizando nossa gestão, expandindo nossa rede de distribuidores para todo o Brasil e com a visão clara de nos tornarmos um dos três maiores players do setor.

O Supervisor Comercial será uma peça-chave na transformação e estruturação da nossa área de vendas. Buscamos um profissional com perfil "mão na massa", que não apenas gerencie, mas também construa processos, desenvolva a equipe e execute a estratégia comercial em campo. Este líder colaborará diretamente com a Diretoria Comercial para refinar e implementar o planejamento estratégico, sendo o elo fundamental entre a gestão e a força de vendas. O candidato ideal é um construtor, motivado pelo desafio de criar uma máquina de vendas robusta em um ambiente familiar, ágil e com grande potencial de crescimento.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Gestão e Desenvolvimento da Equipe de Vendas: Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe de representantes comerciais, incluindo profissionais experientes, estabelecendo uma cultura de alta performance, disciplina e foco em resultados. Recrutar, contratar e treinar novos representantes para expansão de territórios. Implementar e garantir a execução de rotinas de vendas diárias e semanais (planejamento de rotas, prospecção, positivação, follow-up). Realizar rotas em campo com a equipe para suporte, treinamento, avaliação da execução no ponto de venda e atendimento a clientes estratégicos.
  2. Estratégia e Planejamento Comercial: Colaborar com a Diretoria na definição de metas de faturamento, volume, positivação e mix de produtos. Analisar dados de vendas para identificar oportunidades de crescimento, rentabilização e otimização de esforços. Desenvolver e implementar políticas comerciais, incluindo estratégias de precificação, descontos e comissionamento, com base em pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência. Planejar a expansão para novos mercados e canais de venda.
  3. Execução e Trade Marketing: Garantir excelência na execução no ponto de venda. Desenvolver ações de trade marketing para aumentar a visibilidade, o giro dos produtos e fortalecer a marca nos canais de venda. Gerenciar o relacionamento com distribuidores, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e desempenho.
  4. Processos e Análise de Dados: Ser o guardião dos KPIs, analisando resultados e reportando à diretoria para tomadas de decisão rápidas e precisas. Participar da transição de gestão manual de pedidos para um sistema automatizado e integrado, colaborando com a equipe interna. Fornecer insights do campo e da equipe de vendas para o planejamento de S&OP, conectando demandas comerciais à capacidade produtiva e logística.

Qualificações e Perfil do Candidato:

  • Experiência Essencial: Sólida experiência em gestão de equipes de vendas externas (representantes comerciais, vendedores), preferencialmente no setor de bens de consumo, higiene e limpeza, ou em distribuidores. Vivência prática em campo, realizando rotas e negociações B2B. Habilidade com dados e indicadores (KPIs). Experiência na definição e implementação de políticas comerciais e ações de trade marketing. Histórico de sucesso em expansão de mercado e contratação de representantes. Conhecimento do mercado de limpeza será um diferencial.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Liderança resiliente e inspiradora, capaz de gerenciar perfis diversos pelo exemplo, respeito e foco em objetivos comuns. Inteligência emocional e habilidades de negociação para construir relacionamentos sólidos, mediar conflitos e negociar eficazmente. Perfil "construtor" e "mão na massa": proativo, confortável em ambientes com poucos processos, enxergando oportunidades de criá-los e implementá-los com a equipe. Visão de dono: age com autonomia, responsabilidade e senso de urgência na resolução de problemas e captura de oportunidades. Disciplina e organização essenciais para rotinas eficazes em ambientes dinâmicos.

Descrição da vaga. Buscamos pessoas que sejam inovadoras, que possuam foco nos resultados, preocupação com a segurança e que estejam comprometidas com as pessoas. Acreditamos que nossa força vem de um trabalho colaborativo. Sempre buscamos inovar para oferecer as melhores soluções aos nossos clientes internos e externos. Por isso, nos dedicamos à busca contínua da excelência. Se você acredita que pode fazer a diferença, junte-se ao nosso time. Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, pessoas com deficiência, LGBTQIAPN+ e/ou de diferentes gerações. #VemSerTelemont.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Organizar e coordenar o transporte de mercadorias garantindo que as entregas sejam feitas de forma eficiente e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Armazenar produtos de forma organizada e segura e distribuí‑los conforme as necessidades dos clientes;
  • Manter registros precisos do estoque disponível, monitorando os níveis de estoque e garantindo que haja um equilíbrio adequado entre a oferta e a demanda;
  • Gerenciar o processo de logística reversa, lidando com devoluções de produtos, reciclagem, descarte e recondicionamento de mercadorias;
  • Receber, processar e rastrear pedidos de clientes, garantindo que sejam atendidos de maneira eficiente e que os clientes sejam informados sobre o status de seus pedidos;
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores, negociando contratos, resolvendo problemas e garantindo que os produtos sejam entregues dentro dos padrões de qualidade e prazo acordados;
  • Utilizar sistemas de gerenciamento de armazém (WMS), sistemas de rastreamento de frota e outras tecnologias de logística para otimizar as operações e melhorar a eficiência;
  • Coletar e analisar dados relacionados às operações logísticas, identificando tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Avaliar e gerenciar os riscos associados às operações logísticas, desenvolvendo planos de contingência e implementando medidas preventivas para minimizar impactos negativos;
  • Fornecer suporte aos clientes, respondendo a perguntas, resolvendo problemas e garantindo um alto nível de satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços logísticos prestados;
  • Ter conhecimento e certificação válida para operar empilhadeira;
  • Zelar pela organização, limpeza e segurança na área em que trabalha;
  • Executar outras atividades de mesma natureza, nível de complexidade e responsabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Necessário experiência na função;
  • Desejável possuir curso de operador de empilhadeira.

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio academia;
  • Vale refeição ou alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Descontos em farmácias e lojas parceiras.

Horário de Trabalho: comercial, de segunda a sexta-feira.

PRESENÇA ESTRATÉGICA | QUALIDADE | INOVAÇÃO

Conectar pessoas, empresas e projetos faz parte do DNA da Telemont. Há 50 anos, realizamos serviços essenciais para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, se destacando nos segmentos de telecomunicações, energia e TI. Estamos presentes em 10 estados e no Distrito Federal, atuando em áreas como comunicação de voz, banda larga e dados, tecnologia da informação, transporte multimídia e gestão de sistemas de energia. Contamos com um time de profissionais que traduzem em ações os nossos valores, garantindo a excelência operacional e a qualidade em seus atendimentos. Além disso, somos uma empresa que busca promover uma maior diversidade e inclusão, pois acreditamos que a pluralidade das nossas equipes traz mais conhecimento, respeito às múltiplas possibilidades de vivência, inovação e integração entre as áreas. Essa incansável procura por vencer desafios e conquistar novas oportunidades faz a Telemont ser uma empresa onde cada pessoa tem a possibilidade de crescer e se desenvolver profissionalmente, construindo assim, junto com a organização, uma trajetória de sucesso.

  • Operar de modo seguro
  • Satisfação do cliente
  • Resultados sustentáveis
  • Excelência em gente
  • Respeito e simplicidade
  • Colaboração

title: Director of Business Development
description:
Director of Business Development (West Coast)

Stadler offers a wide range of international career opportunities. Here you get the chance to expand your potential, take on meaningful responsibilities, and deliver outstanding performance within dedicated teams. We are looking for motivated individuals who want to shape the mobility of tomorrow with us. Are you ready to achieve great things with us?

The Director of Business Development will lead our sales strategy, focusing on expanding our market presence in the west coast passenger rail industry. This role is not just about selling products but involves understanding the unique needs of our clients, public procurement processes, building long-term partnerships, and contributing to the evolution of public transportation systems. In this role, you will lead policy and government relations efforts at the state-level, develop close relationships and maintain constant oversight of passenger rail funding and legislation in key states—such as California.

This role requires experience in the rail/rolling stock industry.

Key Activities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve revenue targets and West Coast market growth
  • Participate in internal and external customer meetings and assigning and following up on action items.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive dynamics within the passenger rail industry
  • Maintain a pipeline of projects in the Sales Database with accurate data in accordance with the Global Sales Process.
  • Nurture sales leads in your respective territory, focused on long-term relationship development and management.
  • Plan and advocate for Stadler’s policy priorities in key states such as California.
  • Collaborate across multiple departments and teams to ensure customer requirements are met throughout the design, manufacturing, and delivery processes. Support project management in delivering on time and within budget.
  • Manage and mentor other sales professionals, as applicable, fostering a high-performance culture. Provide guidance and support to ensure direct reports meet their objectives and develops professionally.
  • Represent Stadler at industry events, trade shows, and conferences.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree is required, Master’s Degree is preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in business development in a leadership level
  • Experience in rail/rolling stock is required
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Proven track record of establishing and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders
  • Extensive knowledge of the local market (west coast) from both a business and technical standpoint
  • Fluent in English, German is a plus
  • Strong computer proficiency, including Office Suite
  • Ability to travel (30%)
  • Ability to relocate to Salt Lake City, UT

What we offer

  • 401(k) with employer match after 90 days
  • Generous Paid Time Off / 10 Paid Holidays / Extended Paid Holiday (Dec. 25 - Jan 1)
  • Tuition and training reimbursement
  • Paid maternity and parental leave
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

Stadler US is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Fornecedor Conteudista Validador Técnico - Inteligência Artificial no Agronegócio
description:
Precisamos de um(a) fornecedor(a) com experiência em criar conteúdos educacionais, sólido conhecimento sobre Bases da IA – conceitos, evolução, tipos e algoritmos aplicáveis. Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

PARA PRESTAR ESTE SERVIÇO VOCÊ PRECISA DE:

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

  • Acompanhar os resultados de receita e performance de vendas, propondo ações de melhoria;
  • Desenvolver diagnósticos e análises baseadas em dados para identificar oportunidades de evolução das ofertas publicitárias;

  • Compor relatórios e apoiar materiais executivos.

Do que você precisa

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Comunicação, Publicidade, Economia ou Marketing desejável;
  • Pós-graduação desejável em Gestão de Negócios, Ciência de Dados ou Marketing;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de streaming, dos modelos de negócios de publicidades, e seus desafios de crescimento;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para interpretar dados para a criação de critérios e alvos de geração de valor ao consumidor e ao negócio, e na sequência traduzir em planos de ação;
  • Experiência no mercado publicitário brasileiro, com domínio de dados de pesquisa de mídia e métricas de campanhas publicitárias, gestão de orçamento e metas de receita, análises de mercado, preferencialmente em serviços digitais de conteúdo.
  • Conhecimento do mercado publicitário brasileiro, capaz de fazer análises e diagnósticos sobre as necessidades dos anunciantes e do negócio;
  • Tenacidade comercial e espírito empreendedor;

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Information Technology Manager at LEDN

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.

You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.

You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • Knowledge of working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience to people in multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • Writing skills in tickets, email or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing style; sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Knowledge of PGP and commitment to security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Ability to troubleshoot according to OSI model layers methodically.
  • Self‑management and ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills.
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (experience with these environments). No certifications required.
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to reduce effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

Competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Selection Process

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
